description: This Java class 'BroadcastNotifier' handles sending local broadcast intents within an Android application using LocalBroadcastManager. It provides methods to broadcast status updates and log messages to other components within the app.

classes.name: BroadcastNotifier
classes.description: A utility class for sending local broadcast intents within the application.

methods.name: BroadcastNotifier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LocalBroadcastManager instance using the provided Context.

methods.name: broadcastIntentWithState
methods.description: Sends a broadcast with a status integer, indicating work request status.

methods.name: notifyProgress
methods.description: Sends a log message as a broadcast intent.
